focus.title: 美国拟对东南亚光伏产品加征反规避关税，中国出口企业需重估供应链布局
focus.summary: 美国商务部于近期公布初步裁定，认为部分在东南亚组装的太阳能产品规避了对中国产品的反倾销/反补贴税令，拟对来自泰国、越南、马来西亚、柬埔寨的进口光伏电池及组件加征关税。此举将直接冲击中国企业在东南亚设立的产能，出口企业需尽快评估原产地规则、供应链合规及替代市场策略，并考虑在美本土化生产或调整第三国采购方案。
focus.source: 来源：美国商务部（DOC）初步裁定 · 2026.08.13
focus.title_en: U.S. Proposes Anti-Circumvention Tariffs on Southeast Asian Solar Products, Chinese Exporters Urged to Reassess Supply Chains
focus.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Commerce has issued a preliminary determination that certain solar products assembled in Southeast Asia circumvent antidumping/countervailing duty orders on Chinese goods, proposing additional tariffs on imports from Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Cambodia. This move directly impacts Chinese enterprises with production bases in the region. Exporters should promptly evaluate rules of origin, supply chain compliance, and alternative market strategies, considering U.S. local manufacturing or adjusting third-country procurement plans.
focus.source_en: Source: U.S. Department of Commerce (DOC) Preliminary Determination · 2026.08.13

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决获中国法院承认与执行，仲裁条款独立性再获支持
case.summary: 近期，中国某中级人民法院裁定承认并执行新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）作出的一项涉外商事仲裁裁决。该案中，被申请人以主合同无效为由主张仲裁条款无效，但法院依据仲裁条款独立性原则，认定仲裁协议效力独立于主合同，且仲裁程序符合双方约定，故裁定予以承认和执行。此案为跨境争议解决提供了积极信号，强化了中国法院支持国际仲裁的司法立场。
case.source: 来源：中国法院网案例报道 · 2026.08.13
case.title_en: Chinese Court Enforces SIAC Award, Reinforcing Independence of Arbitration Clauses
case.summary_en: A Chinese intermediate people's court recently recognized and enforced an arbitral award rendered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) in a commercial dispute. The respondent argued that the arbitration clause was invalid because the underlying contract was void. The court, applying the principle of separability of arbitration agreements, held that the validity of the arbitration clause is independent of the main contract and that the arbitral procedure complied with the parties' agreement, thus granting recognition and enforcement. This case signals a pro-arbitration stance and reinforces China's supportive judicial attitude toward international arbitration.
case.source_en: Source: Report on China Court Website · 2026.08.13

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规出台，企业合规迎来明确指引
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室于近期发布《粤港澳大湾区个人信息跨境流动标准合同办法》，为区内企业向香港、澳门传输个人信息提供了标准化合同文本及备案流程。该办法明确了数据出境的安全评估要求、个人信息保护影响评估义务，并简化了高频次、低风险场景的合规程序。此举有助于降低企业合规成本，促进大湾区数据要素有序流动，建议相关企业尽快对照新规完善内部数据治理机制。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.08.13
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Provide Clear Compliance Guidance
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province recently issued the 'Standard Contract Measures for Cross-Border Flow of Personal Information in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area,' providing a standardized contract template and filing procedures for enterprises transferring personal information to Hong Kong and Macao. The measures clarify security assessment requirements, obligations for personal information protection impact assessments, and streamline compliance procedures for high-frequency, low-risk scenarios. This reduces compliance costs and facilitates orderly cross-border data flow in the GBA. Enterprises are advised to promptly align their internal data governance frameworks with the new rules.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.08.13

analysis.title: 美国出口管制实体清单扩容趋势下，中国企业如何构建弹性合规体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：近期美国商务部频繁将中国实体列入出口管制实体清单，且管制范围向人工智能、半导体设备等新兴技术领域延伸。为应对这一趋势，企业应建立动态的受限方筛查机制，将清单更新嵌入业务流程；同时加强供应链溯源，识别境外交易的管制物项风险；并考虑在合同中设置出口管制合规条款，明确不可抗力或合规免责情形。此外，建议企业建立内部出口管制培训体系，提升全员合规意识，必要时引入外部律师进行专项审计。
analysis.title_en: Building Resilient Compliance Systems for Chinese Enterprises Amid Expanding U.S. Entity List
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The U.S. Department of Commerce has recently expanded the Entity List to include more Chinese entities, with controls extending to emerging technologies such as AI and semiconductor equipment. To address this trend, enterprises should establish dynamic screening mechanisms for restricted parties, integrate list updates into business processes, strengthen supply chain traceability to identify controlled items in cross-border transactions, and include export control compliance clauses in contracts to clarify force majeure or compliance defenses. Additionally, it is advisable to implement internal training programs to enhance compliance awareness and consider engaging external counsel for specialized audits when necessary.
